slides.heading: in Membership
slides.body: in Membership is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: in Membership
slides.body: The in operator checks whether a value exists in a list. It returns True or False.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Membership with in is like checking whether a name appears on a class list.
